buildings.how: BS1 is the Overture buildings theme as downloaded. BS2 is our own merge in priority order OSM, Google Open Buildings (confidence 0.7 or more), Microsoft: a later footprint is added only where it covers less than 20 percent of footprints already taken, dropped as the same building from 50 percent, and logged as a conflict in between (tools/bake/buildings.ts). Duplicates left are pairs where the smaller footprint lies 60 percent or more inside the larger. Coverage is the share of the box under any footprint (sample grid, no double count).

overrides.how: Sample OV1 patches in harness/data/overrides/<district>/<tileX>_<tileZ>.json (250 m tiles of the district frame, filed under the tile of the anchor). Run 1 applies them to the extract as fetched: targets are found by id. Run 2 is the same extract with every way id changed (a stand-in for a new extract where ways were redrawn): targets must be found again by the anchor. After each run the rules run again: a patch that changes the map (set_tag, remove) makes its issue go away (gone); a patch that only decides (terminate, connect) leaves the issue found and marks it overridden, so it is not raised again.
